# Senior LLM Engineer

## Company
AI Global Tech Solutions

## Job Description
We are looking for a Senior LLM Engineer to build multi-agent systems using LangGraph and Python. You will be responsible for creating autonomous agents that can code, plan, and execute complex workflows.

## Required Skills
- Python (Expert)
- LangChain / LangGraph
- LLM Fine-tuning
- Docker / Kubernetes
- PostgreSQL

## Preferred Skills
- React / Next.js
- AWS Bedrock
- GraphQL

## Responsibilities
- Architect and build multi-agent systems
- Optimize LLM inference pipelines
- Deploy AI applications to production
- Mentor junior engineers

## Qualifications
- BS/MS in Computer Science
- 5+ years of software engineering experience
- 2+ years of experience with LLMs
